## Scope boundary — read before tailoring

The organization delivers **education, psychoeducation, and wraparound support**,
and **connects clients to** outpatient and intensive outpatient treatment. It
does not itself provide clinical SUD treatment.

Several solicitations on the pipeline are titled as treatment programs. Do not
describe the organization as a treatment provider to fit one. Either confirm the
funder accepts a referral-partner structure, or apply with a treatment provider
as partner. Misrepresenting the service model is both a scoring risk and, in a
federal application, a false statement.
